story: My bike was stolen outside my office and I claimed ₹72,000 from Raksha General Insurance. They rejected the claim on 14 April 2025 because I had reported the theft late. I wrote a formal complaint to their grievance cell on 2 May 2025, and on 30 May 2025 they replied that the rejection stands. I let it go at the time, but it still feels unfair. Can I still do something?
